spec.headline: Integrated Marketing | Content Strategy | Digital Operations
spec.headline_rationale: Precision AQ needs multichannel coordination, content, cross-functional leadership, analytics and scalable AI-supported processes. The master supports these areas; healthcare specialization, ABM program ownership, events and earned media results are not asserted.
spec.summary: Integrated digital marketing leader connecting content, paid media, websites and measurement to business priorities. Directed marketing and e-commerce execution across sales, operations, finance, IT and product teams, and led an eight-person team serving U.S., Canadian and U.K. markets. Developed personalized content across blogs, mail, email and websites, paired with campaign testing and leadership KPI reporting. Brings agency consulting, automated cross-channel reporting and hands-on marketing systems work to coordinating teams and improving execution.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Precision AQ Director Integrated Marketing description. Master supports E060/E065/E066/E093/E096/E114/E076/E009 and current tools. No claim of healthcare/life sciences expertise, Demandbase proficiency, earned media, event or formal ABM results.
spec.tools_rationale: Master-supported CRM, analytics, reporting and AI tools align with Precision AQ's stated operational and measurement priorities without inventing Demandbase experience.
